title: Bought it Dec 31? That alone doesn't count
label: Myth vs fact

captions.instagram:
Myth: buy business equipment by December 31 and it's a 2026 write-off.
Fact: the IRS starts the deduction when the property is placed in service, meaning ready and available for its use. Paying for it is not enough.

✔️ Paid and set up by Dec 31: counts for 2026.
✔️ Paid in December but delivered in January: it belongs to 2027.
✔️ Small purchases: the de minimis safe harbor lets many businesses expense items up to $2,500 per invoice or item.
✔️ Keep the receipt and a note of the date you started using it.

Ordering this month? Check the delivery date first.

Source: IRS Publication 946; IRS tangible property regulations FAQ. General information, not advice for your situation.
